list.text: You! How dare you enter uninvited!
We're interested in strong Pokémon.\nThat's my theme!
The Shrine ahead is home to the Master of our Dragon Tamer clan.
You're not allowed to just go in!
A shrine revering the Dragon Pokémon said to have lived in Dragon's Den.
Soon I'm going to get permission from our Master to use dragons.
When I do, I'm going to become and admirable Dragon Tamer and gain our Master's approval.
\f[clair2]Clair:\r I'm sorry about this.\nHere, take this as my apology.

then.text: \f[clair2]\rWell, Dragon Pulse is a kind of er...\nnever mind!
\f[clair2]\rIt's a huge energy of some kind.\nIf you don't want it, you don't have to take it.
\f[clair2]\rWhat's the matter?\nIf you are headed to the Pokémon League, go back to New bark Town and surf along Route 27.
\f[clair2]\rYour face...is telling me you have some unfinished business...
\f[clair2]\rWhatever you have to face from now, don't you dare give up!
\f[clair2]\rIf you do, I'll feel even worse about having lost to you!\nGive it your all.
